concepts.title: GPT6充值，先认清使用入口
concepts.claim: 同一模型名称不等于同一购买对象，ChatGPT、Codex登录来源与API项目需分开看。
concepts.relation: One model name branches into three different product contexts and billing ledgers; no automatic upgrade or unique model card is implied.
concepts.reference: xiaowei-cartoon-reference-v2.png used only for simplified black hair, square glasses and black-shirt identity; one original vector character per figure.
concepts.method: Original deterministic SVG, WebP rasterization. Precise technical labels; no copied competitor artwork.

concepts.title: Pro变更，保存前后两份记录
concepts.claim: 变更前的续费记录、确认页显示与实际新计划是不同证据；不画统一即刻生效和差价公式。
concepts.relation: Compare the same account before and after a proposed change; confirmation fields determine the terms, then actual entitlement is checked separately.

concepts.title: 自动补充：低于阈值，补到目标
concepts.claim: 可用时低于minimum触发usage credits购买到target，月自动购买上限不覆盖手动购买。
concepts.relation: Threshold-triggered refill of usage credits from the default payment method, with a cap on only the automatic branch.

concepts.title: 跨过272K，整次换长上下文价
concepts.claim: Standard无缓存合成算例中，270K入+2K总输出为2.80美元，300K入+2K总输出为6.15美元；阈值只看输入且影响整次请求。
concepts.relation: An input threshold selects the full request rate table, not a marginal surcharge; same output baseline, explicitly synthetic amounts.

concepts.claim: 身份、模型权限、余额/硬限额和临时速率问题需要不同处理，补余额不是所有分支的答案。
concepts.relation: A recorded error branches into separate diagnostic actions; all429s are not equivalent, and no branch promises success.
